input.quote: (iv) and each Party will return or destroy any of the other Party's Confidential Information then in its possession.
input.rationale: Section 4(c) sets out the only effects of termination: Kubient ceases the Services, the licence is revoked, Customer stops using the Auction Platform, and each Party returns or destroys the other's Confidential Information. There is no transition assistance obligation and no obligation to export or return Customer's data (as distinct from Confidential Information), and no timing for either. Nothing elsewhere in the Agreement (including the survival language in 14(f)) supplies these obligations, so the rule's fallback is unmet and we insert the shortest conforming clause at the fallback level: transition assistance of at least 90 days on expiry or termination and export of Customer's data within 30 days. We have not added the preferred six-month/then-current-rates, machine-readable format or certified-deletion terms.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data export obligation in the termination section
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The termination section only requires return or destruction of Confidential Information, with no exit help or data export, so we have added our fallback position: 90 days of transition assistance on expiry or termination and export of our data within 30 days.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Kubient shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days and shall, within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, export and deliver to Customer all data of Customer in Kubient's possession or control.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
